findings.description: Rafael Reyes and Serapia Benavides Cueva had a daughter, Rita Reyes, born and died in January 1913 (death registered 22 July 1932, Santa Elena, Usulután — the registration itself dated decades after the death).
supporting_sources: El Salvador, Civil Registration, 1704-2001 — death registration, 22 Jul 1932, Santa Elena, Usulután, naming parents Manuel Rafael Reyes and Serapia Benavides
